## 1. The Conceptual Shift: The Death of Vector Calculus

Exterior differential forms $\Omega^k(M)$ and the nilpotent exterior derivative $d$ ($d^2 = 0$) unify all classical theorems into **Generalized Stokes**:
$$\int_{\partial M} \omega = \int_M d\omega$$
De Rham cohomology $H^k_{\text{dR}}(M) = \ker(d_k)/\text{im}(d_{k-1})$ links calculus to topology.

## 2. Numerical Computation: Discrete Exterior Derivative on Simplicial 1-Skeletons

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}
## Python 3
```python
import numpy as np

# Triangular 1-skeleton: edges (0->1), (1->2), (2->0)
edges = np.array([[0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 0]])
f_0form = np.array([1.0, 4.0, 9.0]) # Vertex potentials

# Discrete coboundary d0: df(e_ij) = f(j) - f(i)
df = np.array([f_0form[j] - f_0form[i] for i, j in edges])
print(f"Python 3: Edge 1-forms df = {df}, Closed Loop Sum = {np.sum(df)}")
```

## C++20
```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <array>

int main() {
    std::vector<std::array<int, 2>> edges{{0, 1}, {1, 2}, {2, 0}};
    std::vector<double> f{1.0, 4.0, 9.0};
    double sum = 0.0;

    std::cout << "C++20:    Edge 1-forms: ";
    for (auto& e : edges) {
        double df = f[e[1]] - f[e[0]];
        std::cout << df << " ";
        sum += df;
    }
    std::cout << "| Loop Sum = " << sum << "\n";
    return 0;
}
```

## Julia
```julia
edges = [(1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 1)]
f = [1.0, 4.0, 9.0]
df = [f[j] - f[i] for (i, j) in edges]
println("Julia:    Edge 1-forms = $(df) | Loop Sum = $(sum(df))")
```

## Modern Fortran
```fortran
program dec_d0
  implicit none
  integer :: edges(3, 2)
  real(8) :: f(3), df(3)
  integer :: k

  edges(1, :) = [1, 2]
  edges(2, :) = [2, 3]
  edges(3, :) = [3, 1]
  f = [1.0d0, 4.0d0, 9.0d0]

  do k = 1, 3
    df(k) = f(edges(k, 2)) - f(edges(k, 1))
  end do

  print '(A,3F6.1,A,F5.1)', "Fortran:  Edge 1-forms = ", df, " | Loop Sum = ", sum(df)
end program dec_d0
```

## MATLAB / Octave
```matlab
edges = [1, 2; 2, 3; 3, 1];
f = [1.0, 4.0, 9.0];
df = f(edges(:, 2)) - f(edges(:, 1));
fprintf('MATLAB:   Edge 1-forms = [%.1f, %.1f, %.1f] | Loop Sum = %.1f\n', df(1), df(2), df(3), sum(df));
```
:::
